author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I transferred my domains from Squarespace to Cloudflare.

Google sold its domain registry to Squarespace a few years ago, I never bother to migrate.  With the AI revolution, the business model of Squarespace will not survive as a its old self.   To make it worse, Squarespace is owned by private equity, it will NOT get the investment to keep up with the AI revolution.

I don't want my domains locked behind a dead company with Squarespace turn off the lights and shut its doors.   Claudeflare will be a leader in the next phase of AI adoption.   Oh yes, I have some NET shares too.

DON'T use any vendor if you are not willing to own its shares.
